summary.text: Randy Fine is the incumbent Republican U.S. Representative for Florida's 6th District, elected in an April 2025 special election. A Harvard graduate and former business founder, he served in the Florida House from 2016 to 2024 and briefly in the Florida Senate before Congress. He serves on the Education and Workforce and Foreign Affairs committees.

paragraphs.text: Fine was born in Tucson, Arizona; according to his House biography, he is a third-generation Floridian and the son of two public school teachers.
He graduated from Harvard College in 1996 with a degree in government and earned an MBA from Harvard Business School in 1998.

Fine founded The Fine Point Group and worked as a technology consultant. His House biography says he founded and ran businesses in retail, technology, and hospitality and retired from the private sector at 40. It also says he has been a Boy Scout volunteer, including as Cubmaster and Assistant Scoutmaster, and has two sons with his wife, Wendy.
Fine served in the Florida House of Representatives from 2016 to 2024, and his House biography says he chaired five committees and passed more than forty bills.
He won Florida Senate District 19 in November 2024, 59.4% to 40.6% over Vance Ahrens, and served until 2025.

Fine was elected to Congress in the April 1, 2025, special election, 56.7% to Democrat Joshua Weil's 42.7%, for the seat vacated by Mike Waltz, and took office on April 2, 2025. In Congress he serves on the Committee on Education and the Workforce and the Committee on Foreign Affairs.
